name: domain.com.au
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But plain http serves the site without redirecting.
lesson: Redirect every http request to https with one permanent 301, then add HSTS.
summary: The site's bot protection refused the plain request and headless Chrome while it carried the review tag; the page was analyzed in headless Chrome without the tag. Partial analysis: 19 of 19 linked pages answered with a bot check or a block, so the scores rest mostly on the start page. www.domain.com.au scores 50 out of 100 (F). 9 checks fail now, 31 are at risk, and 26 pass. Fix first: tracking…

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Analytics (2 requests), Google Ads (1 request), and cookies _s on app.link, _ga_HFSVJ1Z577, _ga.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 403. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: Next.js 15.5.22 has known flaws
fix.evidence: Next.js 15.5.22 (banner of https://s.domainstatic.com.au/fe-server-domain-home/master-2239/_next/static/chunks/main-61bfa5234e89cd05.js): 4 known flaws, the worst rated critical, such as GHSA-2xp9-vwfh-vxw4, CVE-2026-75604, CVE-2026-94543. Next.js:…

fix.title: Scripts fingerprint the browser before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, www.domain.com.au drew hidden text on a canvas and read it back, read the graphics card name, and rendered a silent audio tone. Read together, these give the browser an ID that survives clearing cookies.
fix.fix: Find the tag behind each host and hold it until consent, like a tracking cookie. If it is fraud or bot protection, name it in the privacy notice.

fix.title: 1 form control has no label
fix.evidence: On /. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 2 elements on /, for example .css-1ra0hze and .css-zg7yfi. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
The start page declares its language
Images below the first screen wait until they are needed
Every page has a meta description
The start page sets a mobile viewport
